tools.name: list_latest_news
tools.description: List the most recent AlphaSignal items from the last 7 days, optionally filtered to one topic. Returns one line per item with title, URL, publish time and a short preview.

topic.description: Topic slug as it appears in /topic/<slug>, for example llms or computer-vision.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open an AlphaSignal page in this tab: a topic hub, company hub, author hub, article, or a search results page. Returns the URL that was opened.

slug.description: Topic slug, company or author username, article slug, or the search query.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search AlphaSignal's AI news, papers, models and repos by keyword. Returns one line per result with title, URL, publish time and a short preview.
